sentence_stem: Sorry for the late reply, because
correct_completion: I was busy with my exams all week.
full_sentence: Sorry for the late reply, because I was busy with my exams all week.
acceptable_variants: my exams took up all my time.
I had a lot of work this week.

options.text: so I was busy with my exams.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result, and it cannot follow 'because' to introduce a cause.
This is a future promise, not a reason, so it does not complete a 'because' clause.

options.text: I was busy with my exams all week.
busy with my exams all week.
options.why_wrong: This clause has no subject, so it is not a complete clause after 'because'. It needs a subject such as 'I'.

grammar_focus: Clauses introduced by 'because' that give the reason for a situation
explanation: After 'because', we need a full clause with its own subject and verb that gives the reason for the delay. Turkish speakers often put the cause before the verb as a noun phrase, so learners may leave out the subject here.
translation: Geç cevap verdiğim için özür dilerim, çünkü bütün hafta sınavlarla meşguldüm.
